f528d8fb37:
Cecily! Why are you on a battlefield...?
You were going to go back to the Ronah family, weren't you...?
05e05afd10:
No! You and everyone else were gone,
and there was nothing else I could do!
I'm still Cecily Fairchild!
450de2a8e0:
The Federation's eyes don't reach Jupiter, so far from
Earth. Only we can stop their ambitions now!
Please, everyone, lend us your strength!
7388c7a2e4:
Right now I'm Kincade Nau.
Until Berah... until she gets her real name back...
7a35644546:
It would be trouble if the Federation learned of us.
We'll move faster than the enemy can respond, and
strike the Jupiter Empire's secret base with everything!
5449a81914:
To think they built a base like this right under Earth's nose!
Kincade, Crossbone Gundam X1, launching!
8b6ba8bd7d:
U.C. 0123. To overthrow the corrupt Earth Federation,
the Ronah family, preaching "Cosmo Aristocracy," rose
to power with its private army, the Crossbone Vanguard.
c8ad306ff6:
Seabook Arno, a boy living in Frontier IV, was caught
up in the fighting and, as part of the resistance, became
the pilot of the Gundam F91 his mother developed.
ea7272089d:
His childhood friend Cecily Fairchild, as the Ronah
heiress Berah Ronah, was for a time his enemy, but
they reconciled and drove off the Crossbone Vanguard.
c4de0aae9b:
Ten years later... U.C. 0133.
It was an era of peace without major wars, but
pirates had begun to appear in the Jupiter Sphere.
533f4c1a3e:
They were the space pirates "Crossbone Vanguard,"
reformed by Cecily, who gathered supporters after
learning the Jupiter Empire planned to invade Earth.
eed2d4faa7:
Beside her, once again calling herself Berah Ronah,
was Seabook, now named Kincade Nau, the ace
of the new Crossbone Vanguard.
5caf00bdcb:
The two threw themselves into the fight against the
Jupiter Empire. Back at Earth for maintenance and supplies,
they found a secret Empire base on an abandoned asteroid.
5b7a14bf7a:
No good. Every database and device that might have had
information has been destroyed... The mobile suits all
self-destructed. No proof of a revolt against the Federation...
71407a7e95:
It's very likely the Federation showing up
was a trap too...
To make us and them wipe each other out...
1d9f2ea5e0:
Either way, we're the only ones who can really
stand up to them. Trap or not,
we've got no choice but to do it.
d264411008:
Yes, you're right... Hurry and recover the mobile suits!
As soon as maintenance and resupply are done,
we set out for the Jupiter Sphere!
9d8c32f0d6:
Thanks to Kincade and the others, the Jupiter Empire's
forces withdrew. They tried to recover data from the base
on the Empire's strength and the Leader's whereabouts...
03871c9b91:
Outwardly keeping up a friendly stance toward the
Federation, the Jupiter Empire waited for its chance
to invade Earth... Their enemy was far too powerful.
864f3f4e32:
A man and a woman who cast away their names to
stop a war... Their fight against the Jupiter Empire
had only just begun.
